analysis: POC Phase 2 — cross-field bridge (Test 5): pronephros (N3) <-> ocular (N5)
method: Method 2 (instrumented; cross-field-bridge-agent role, Phase I — hypothesis, not decision)
persisted_because: composite-auditor closing gate (auditor 3) flagged the only-ocular=0 finding as run-live-but-not-persisted; this file is the durable, auditable artifact.
artifact_verdict: The 40-entity MENTIONS overlap is an ANNOTATION ARTIFACT, NOT co-regulation evidence. Both datasets' entities_extracted were populated from the SAME curated marker panel (the 46-entity verified store mixes pronephros + ocular markers), so the overlap reflects shared annotation, not shared expression. only_ocular=0 is the tell: biologically the ocular dataset must have ocular-specific genes absent from pronephros; finding none means the panel, not the biology, drove the overlap. The graph cannot adjudicate a genuine cross-field bridge from MENTIONS alone — that requires expression data (fetch_raw -> count matrices, co-expression) or literature (the answer-pipeline Path B).

bridge_hypothesis.tier: HYPOTHESIS — causal-pruner-class, requires_human_gate; NOT a finding
bridge_hypothesis.claim: foxc1a (pronephros / intermediate mesoderm) <-> foxc1b (ocular anterior segment) + pitx2 — a conserved foxc1 regulator family operating across both structurally-distinct fields (foxc1/pitx2 is the canonical anterior-segment-dysgenesis module).
bridge_hypothesis.basis: foxc1 paralog biology + the foxc1b ocular dataset (GSE218068 is literally a Foxc1b dataset) — NOT derived from the artifactual dataset overlap above.
bridge_hypothesis.to_confirm: fetch_raw expression co-analysis across the two datasets, OR a Path-B literature pass on foxc1a/foxc1b cross-tissue regulation.

test_5_framing: Exploratory in Phase I (PROJECT_SCOPE §5): modest/preliminary evidence is the realistic positive outcome; absence-of-evidence is data. Ocular (N5) is the structurally-distinct bridge target per ADR-0018.
audited_by: composite-auditor closing gate, 3/3, 2026-06-13: artifact framing APPROVED; bridge relabeled HYPOTHESIS (not finding) per auditor 3; this artifact persisted to make the computation auditable.
